Install sublime-text-4 on Omarchy

Sublime Text is a proprietary text and code editor known for its speed, a distraction-free "Goto Anything" file/symbol jumper, multiple simultaneous cursors, and deep customization through plugins and key bindings. It can be downloaded and evaluated in full for free with no enforced time limit, but continued regular use is expected to be licensed.

Watch: [MG05] Introduction to the new features in Sublime Text 4! ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add sublime-text-4
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 4.4215-2:
    pacman -Qi sublime-text-4

Open and use sublime-text-4

sublime-text-4 is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql sublime-text-4 | grep applications

Frequently asked questions

How do I install sublime-text-4 on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add sublime-text-4. The download is 27.7 MB and it takes 70.9 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is sublime-text-4 free?

$99 one-time personal license (includes 3 years of updates); free unlimited evaluation. The package is licensed custom.

How do I uninstall sublime-text-4?

Run omarchy pkg drop sublime-text-4. It removes the package from your system.

What does sublime-text-4 depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: libpng, gtk3. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is sublime-text-4 a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for sublime-text-4.

Is sublime-text-4 in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as sublime-text-4 (version 4.4215-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Sublime HQ makes it. Project site: https://www.sublimetext.com/download. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
